data.body: Implementation update: offline shadow-clone reclaim-collapse engine is implemented in the s1-collapse-engine worktree. Added RED-first tests for collapse/reduced-state preservation, ledger position re-resolution, enforce_since re-anchor verified by verify-authorship, horizon-ref eligibility enforcement, shadow-clone safety refusal, and CLI dry-run. Targeted suite is green (177 passed), make lint green, make typecheck green. Full non-integration make test was attempted but stopped after an existing lifecycle failure in test_atomic_completion_close.py unrelated to this change; targeted coverage for this story is green.
